# FFmpeg native build metadata

FFmpeg: n6.0; FFmpegKit full: 6.0-2; Android NDK: 22.1.7171670 (r22b).
Library source and build scripts: see THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md.
Path values are replaced with portable placeholders; remaining configure flags are taken from the distributed libraries.
